info.name: Superhuman Docs Admin Account Events API

params.name: startTime
params.description: Return audit events created on or after the given Unix timestamp.

params.name: endTime
params.description: Return audit events created on or before the given Unix timestamp.

params.name: userId
params.description: The Superhuman Docs ID of the user who initiated the action.

params.name: email
params.description: The email address(es) of the user(s) who initiated the action.

params.name: entityType
params.description: Target entity type of the action.

params.name: entityId
params.description: Target entity ID of the action.

params.name: containerWorkspaceId
params.description: ID of the workspace that contained the entity at the time the event was generated.

params.name: containerFolderId
params.description: ID of the folder that contained the entity at the time the event was generated.

params.name: containerBillingAccountId
params.description: ID of the billing account that contained the entity at the time the event was generated.

params.name: order
params.description: Defines the ordering of results. If unspecified, will default to 'asc' (ascending) order from oldest to most recent events.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return in this query.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: An opaque token used to fetch the next page of results.

items.docs: Returns a list of audit events within an organization.
